prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Crafting Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet model, animation rig, and desktop overlays are rendering."]
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Drag to move your pet around, right-click for interactions, or press Alt+P to summon."]
3: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select an archetype and customize traits for your desktop assistant."]
4: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Pet", "Syncing saves your pet's state, custom outfits, and memory securely.", "Pet State Protection Active"]
5: ["Checking Desktop Overlay Permissions", "Ensuring screen overlay compatibility so your pet displays properly on your workspace."]
6: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your companion is live on your desktop. Right-click your pet anytime to configure preferences."]
7: ["Use bright, single-subject photos to avoid pet generation glitches.", "Photo Clarity & Lighting Checklist"]
8: ["Unlocks Exclusive Companion Personality"]
9: ["Press Alt+P to show/hide your pet or right-click the system tray icon to pause companion activity."]

verdicts.problem: mentions exclusive features or paid unlocks
